common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

added.title: Added to the queue
added.truncated: The list was cut to fit the queue limit.

queue.title: Queue in {channel}
queue.empty: Nothing up next. Add songs with `/play`.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.footer: Lyrics from LRCLIB. The panel shows them in sync with the song.

jam.title: Jam from {channel}
jam.body: Share this link. Whoever opens it gets the Lynx panel in their own voice channel and can join the jam: every channel hears the same music at the same time.

paused_empty.title: Paused: nobody is listening
paused_empty.body:
Everyone left {channel}, so the music is paused.
The queue will be deleted {time} if nobody joins.

queue_deleted.title: Queue deleted
queue_deleted.body: Nobody joined {channel} in {minutes} minutes, so I cleared the queue and left the channel.

back_online.title: Back online
back_online.body: Lynx restarted. Picking up where you left off in {channel}: {track}, song {position} of {total}.

queue_finished.title: Queue finished
queue_finished.body: That was the last song in {channel}. Add more with `/play`.
queue_finished.body_ai: That was the last song in {channel}. Add more with `/play`, or start a radio based on your taste.

too_many_failures.title: Playback stopped
too_many_failures.body: Several songs in a row could not be played, so I stopped the music in {channel}.

disconnected.title: Disconnected
disconnected.body: I was disconnected from {channel}, so the queue was deleted.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.body: {user} stopped the music and I left {channel}.

jam_entered.title: Joined the jam of {host}
jam_entered.body: {channel} plays the jam's shared queue now. Its own queue is saved and comes back when it leaves the jam.

jam_joined.title: {channel} joined the jam
jam_joined.body: {count} channels hear the same music now.

jam_left.title: {channel} left the jam
jam_left.body: {count} channels are still in the jam.

jam_host.title: {channel} is the jam host now
jam_host.body: The previous host channel left the jam.
jam_host.body_own: The host channel left, so the jam settings are decided here now.

jam_ended.title: The jam ended
jam_ended.body_restored: {channel} is back to its own queue.

jam_empty.title: Nobody is listening here
jam_empty.body: Everyone left {channel}. Lynx will leave the jam and disconnect {time} if nobody joins.

jam_back.title: Still in the jam
jam_back.body: Someone joined {channel}, so it stays in the jam.

jam_removed.title: This channel was removed from the jam
jam_removed.body: {channel} is back to its own queue.

vote.title: Vote to skip: {current} of {required}
vote.body_one: {track} will be skipped when one more listener votes.
vote.body_many: {track} will be skipped when {count} more listeners vote.

busy.title: All Lynx bots are busy in this server
busy.body: Lynx is already playing in {busy}. Add another Lynx so it can play in {channel} at the same time.
busy.body_generic: Add another Lynx so it can play in {channel} at the same time.
busy.no_more: Every Lynx bot is already playing in another voice channel, and there are no more bots to add. Try again when one of them is free to play in {channel}.

invite.title: Invite Lynx
invite.body: Add Lynx to a server to play music in its voice channels. Anyone with the Manage Server permission there can add it.

about.tagline: Music for your voice channels, with a panel that opens right in Discord.

add_main.title: Add the main Lynx
add_main.body: This Lynx plays music when the main Lynx is busy in another channel. To use commands, this server needs the main Lynx too.

modal.title: Start a radio
modal.prompt_label: What do you want to hear?
modal.prompt_description: Optional. Leave it empty to use only your taste.
modal.blend: Blend the taste of everyone in the channel

picking.title: Radio is picking songs
picking.basis: Based on your taste and listeners like you.
picking.basis_prompt: Based on your taste, listeners like you and "{prompt}".
picking.first_playing: The first song is already playing.

on.title: Radio is on
on.body: Added {count} songs to {channel}. More are added when the queue gets short. Stop it with `/stop` or from the panel.
on.body_one: Added 1 song to {channel}. More are added when the queue gets short. Stop it with `/stop` or from the panel.

failed.title: The radio could not start.
failed.no_songs: I could not find songs for your taste yet. Play a few songs with `/play` first, or tell me what you want to hear.
failed.body: Something went wrong while picking songs. Please try again in a moment.

cancelled.title: Radio cancelled.
cancelled.body: Nothing more will be added to {channel}.

stopped.title: Radio stopped.
stopped.body: {user} turned the radio off. The songs already in the queue keep playing.

history_off.title: Your history is turned off
history_off.body: Like, Dislike and the radio use your listening history. Turn it on in the panel, under Privacy.

generic.title: Something went wrong.
generic.body: Please try again in a moment.

guild_only.title: This only works in a server.
guild_only.body: Use Lynx from a server text channel.

not_in_voice.title: Join a voice channel first.
not_in_voice.body: I play music in the voice channel you are in.

no_player.title: Nothing is playing in your voice channel.

not_in_channel.title: You are not in that voice channel.
not_in_channel.body: Join the channel where the music is playing to control it.

dj_only.title: Only DJs can do that here.
dj_only.body: In this server, managers decided that only DJs control the music. You can still add songs and remove your own.

queue_full.title: The queue is full.
queue_full.body: This server allows up to {max} songs in the queue.

no_results.title: Nothing found.
no_results.body: Try another search or paste a link.

cannot_connect.title: I cannot join {channel}.
cannot_connect.body: I need the View Channel, Connect and Speak permissions there.

join_failed.title: Could not connect to the voice channel.
join_failed.body: Please try again in a moment.

command_channel.title: Music commands are not allowed in this channel.

voice_channel.title: Lynx can not play in this voice channel.

outdated.title: This message is outdated.
outdated.body: That song is no longer playing.

spotify_disabled.title: Spotify links are not enabled.
spotify_disabled.body: Search for the song by name instead.

unsupported.title: That link is not supported.
unsupported.body: Use a YouTube, YouTube Music or Spotify link, or search by name.

timeout.title: The source took too long to answer.

source.title: Could not play that.
source.body: {reason}. Try another link or search for the song.

lyrics_not_found.title: No lyrics found.
lyrics_not_found.body: LRCLIB has no lyrics for that song.

no_invite_permission.title: I cannot create invites here.
no_invite_permission.body: Invite to jam needs the Create Invite permission in {channel}.

radio_unavailable.title: The radio is not available.
radio_unavailable.body: The AI radio is turned off on this bot.

radio_no_permission.title: You cannot change this radio.
radio_no_permission.body: Only the person who started it, DJs and managers can.

radio_nothing_to_cancel.title: Nothing to cancel.
radio_nothing_to_cancel.body: The radio already finished picking songs.

nothing_to_shuffle.title: There is nothing to shuffle.
nothing_to_shuffle.body: Add more songs to the queue first.

radio_in_jam.title: The radio does not work in a jam.
radio_in_jam.body: Leave the jam to start a radio in this channel.

jam_host_only.title: Only the jam host channel can change the music.
jam_host_only.body: The host of this jam lets only people in {channel} edit the shared queue.

reply.paused: **Paused.** Use `/resume` or the Resume button to continue.
reply.skipped_last: **Skipped** {track}. That was the last song in the queue.
reply.already_voted: **You already voted.** {current} of {required} votes to skip.
reply.stopped: **Stopped.** I cleared the queue and left {channel}.
reply.skipped_to: **Skipped to** {track}. {count} songs before it were removed.
reply.shuffled: **Shuffled {count} songs.** The song playing now stays in place.
reply.loop_track: **Loop: song**. The current song repeats until you change it.
reply.loop_queue: **Loop: queue**. When the last song ends, the queue starts again.
reply.liked: **Saved.** You will hear more songs like {track} on your radio.
reply.disliked: **Got it.** {track} will not play on your radio again.

play.description: Play a song, a playlist or a search

skip.description: Skip the current song (or vote to skip)

stop.description: Stop the music, clear the queue and leave

remove.description: Remove a song from the queue

move.description: Move a song in the queue

skipto.description: Jump to a position in the queue, dropping the songs before it

volume.value: Volume from 10 to 100 (100 is the original)

lyrics.description: Show the lyrics of the current song or of a search

ai.description: Start a radio based on your taste
ai.prompt: What do you want to hear? (optional)
ai.mix: Your favorites, a balance or new music (default: balanced)
ai.blend: Blend the taste of everyone in the channel (default: on)
